categories.orders: Order records, line items, cancellation, delivery address, fulfillment holds and priorities.
categories.inventory: Warehouse quantities, available versus reserved stock, replenishment, allocation and stock receipts.
categories.shipping: Parcel tracking, delivery forecasts, shipping labels, carriers, addresses and transport rates.
categories.customers: Customer identity, profile, contact information, loyalty points, store credit and consent.
categories.billing: Invoices, payment collection, financial refunds, balances, due dates and payment reminders.
categories.support: Helpdesk tickets, replies, assignments, escalation, SLA and customer issue histories.
categories.marketing: Campaigns, audience segments, coupons, budget, engagement and attribution.
categories.catalog: Product descriptions, prices, costs, classifications, weights, suppliers and active listings.
categories.returns: Physical return authorization, labels, warehouse receipt, inspection, fees and exchanges.
categories.analytics: Computed retail sales, margins, payment exposure, inventory health and operational summaries.

function.name: get_order
function.description: Read a full sales order by order ID.

function.name: list_customer_orders
function.description: Find all orders belonging to a customer.

function.name: get_order_total
function.description: Read the billed sales total, not an outstanding invoice balance.

function.name: get_order_items
function.description: Read ordered SKUs and quantities.

function.name: cancel_order
function.description: Cancel an unshipped order; does not issue a financial refund.

function.name: hold_order
function.description: Pause fulfillment by placing an order on hold.

function.name: release_order_hold
function.description: Resume fulfillment of a held order.

function.name: set_order_priority
